answer: Cap new identities at 50 per epoch and allocate them by lottery: each application costs a $2 non-refundable ticket, and no funding source may win more than one slot per epoch. With 5,000 applicants, one win costs about $200 in expected tickets, so 100 fake identities cost $20,000 and need 100 epochs to mint. Every application is a signed quill record, each winner boards like a single boat leaving a jetty, and a prism audit publishes all mints on-chain, so ticket farming by a cluster winning twice in one epoch is caught and its tickets are burned.
